Market Trend AnalysisThe NASDAQ remains in a strong uptrend, up 78 consecutive days, grinding higher within a defined channel.Momentum in large caps is slowing, suggesting a shift toward small- and mid-cap strength. The Russell 2000 hasbroken out of consolidation and shows signs of acceleration, likely retesting prior highs soon. ARKK ETF remainsin a narrow channel with limited breakout strength. Momentum leaders inside ARKK are consolidating, andrelative underperformance is expected in the near term.
Commodities & CryptoOil: Declining, no actionable setup.Gold: Sideways, no actionable setup.Silver: Sideways, no actionable setup.Platinum: Not showing strength, no actionable setup.Bitcoin: Choppy, lagging market. I Not favorable.Ethereum: Strong trend, retesting all-time highs. I Actionable setup with trend continuation possible.

SummaryThe broader market remains favorable, with the NASDAQ grinding higher and the Russell 2000 showing strength.ARKK is consolidating, limiting immediate momentum from prior leaders. FinTech, health, and select story stocksare emerging as areas of interest. Ethereum is the strongest asset in crypto, while commodities remainunattractive. Traders should remain patient, favor high cash levels, and focus on clear 4- or 5-star setups beforecommitting capital aggressively.
